title: Organosilicon molecules bind to the intrinsically disordered protein NUPR1 by clamping its hot-spots.
authors: Pena, Laura F; Estaras, Matias; Gonzalez-Andres, Paula; Diez-Poza, Carlos; Rizzuti, Bruno; Abian, Olga; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian; Iovanna, Juan L; Santofimia-Castano, Patricia; Neira, Jose L; Barbero, Asuncion
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机硅小分子与固有无序蛋白NUPR1热点区域的结合机制，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和分子模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅部分相关。
abstract: The nuclear protein 1, or NUPR1, is an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) involved in the development and progression of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). We have previously developed drugs capable of binding at the two hot-spot regions of NUPR1, around residues Ala33 and Thr68, hampering its interactions in cellulo. In this work, we synthesized new organosilicon molecules targeting those key hot-spots. The compounds were obtained by an acid-catalyzed intramolecular cyclization of a starting alkenol that contains a silyl group attached to the double bond. Binding between the silyl compounds and NUPR1 involved the two hot-spots, as shown by 2D (1)H-(15)N HSQC NMR. Molecular simulations clarified that the binding relies on a loose clamp mechanism of the ligands towards the hot-spots. The dissociation constants (K(d)) were around 20 muM, as measured by several biophysical techniques. However, studies in cellulo with PDAC cells did not show a decrease of cell viability upon treatment with the compounds; furthermore, proximity ligation assays in cellulo with a natural partner protein of NUPR1, G3BP, did not show a significant level of interfering in such interaction when silyl compounds were present, probably due to the high hydrophobicity of the designed compounds. Thus, in the case of NUPR1, moderate-to-high drug binding affinities (K(d) < 10 muM) in vitro and a higher hydrophilicity are necessary to hamper protein-protein interactions in cellulo. As a more general conclusion, in vitro binding of ligands to the protein hot-spots is a necessary condition in the drug design targeting IDPs, but it is not enough to guarantee inhibition of their interactions in cellulo.
abstract_zh: 核蛋白1（NUPR1）是一种 intrinsically disordered protein (IDP)，参与胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的发生与发展。我们此前已开发出能够结合NUPR1两个热点区域（约在Ala33和Thr68残基处）的药物，从而在细胞水平（in cellulo）阻碍其相互作用。在本研究中，我们合成了靶向这些关键热点的新型有机硅分子。这些化合物通过酸催化的分子内环化反应，由含有与双键相连的硅烷基的起始烯醇制得。二维(1)H-(15)N HSQC NMR显示，硅基化合物与NUPR1的结合涉及两个热点区域。分子模拟阐明，该结合依赖于配体对热点区域的松散夹持机制。通过多种生物物理技术测得的解离常数（K(d)）约为20 μM。然而，在PDAC细胞中的细胞水平研究并未显示化合物处理后细胞活力下降；此外，在细胞水平使用NUPR1天然伙伴蛋白G3BP进行的邻近连接实验表明，当存在硅基化合物时，并未显著干扰该相互作用，这可能是由于所设计化合物的高疏水性。因此，对于NUPR1而言，体外中等至高的药物结合亲和力（K(d) < 10 μM）以及更高的亲水性是阻碍细胞水平蛋白-蛋白相互作用的必要条件。作为更一般的结论，配体在体外与蛋白热点区域的结合是靶向IDP药物设计中的必要条件，但不足以保证其在细胞水平抑制相互作用。
